_activity: Write it: evidence from the Articles
_licence: ORIGINAL, built on the 11.2 casefile documents (numbered per the signed 11.2 map). Quotes are the casefile's adapted text.
source_document: Document 11 — the Articles of Confederation, 1781 (11.2 Casefile B)
source_text: Article VIII. The costs of war and all other common expenses shall be paid out of a common treasury, supplied by the states in proportion to the value of the land in each state. The taxes for that share shall be laid and collected by the legislatures of the several states.
prompt: Use one detail from Document 11 as evidence that the national government was weak. Name the document, quote the detail, and say what it shows.
sentence_starter: In Document 11, the Articles of Confederation say ___
checklist: Did you quote an exact detail?
Did you say what it shows?
model_response: In Document 11, the Articles of Confederation say the taxes for the national treasury “shall be laid and collected by the legislatures of the several states.” This shows that Congress could not tax anyone directly, so it had to wait for the states to pay.
